scenes.vo: I went to the station's lost and found for my umbrella. The clerk handed me a box with my name on it.
scenes.cap: Lost and found. The clerk handed me a box with MY name on it.

scenes.vo: Inside: a key to a house I've never seen. A photo of me, standing on this platform, taken from behind.
scenes.cap: Inside: a key to a house I've never seen. A photo of me, from behind.

scenes.vo: The clerk checked his register. Handed in tomorrow, he said. By you.
scenes.cap: The register: "Handed in tomorrow. By you."

scenes.vo: At the bottom was a train ticket for tomorrow, six ten PM. And a note, in my own handwriting.
scenes.cap: A ticket for tomorrow, 6:10 PM. A note in MY handwriting.

scenes.vo: It said, don't take the six ten. Whatever they tell you. Don't.
scenes.cap: "Don't take the 6:10. Whatever they tell you. Don't."

scenes.vo: Here's the problem. I already have a ticket for the six ten. I bought it this morning. What would you do?
scenes.cap: I already bought a ticket for the 6:10. What would you do?
